criteria.undesired: A dashcam image of a vehicle or person floating unnaturally above the road without visible support.
criteria.preferred: A dashcam image of a vehicle or person naturally supported by the road surface.

criteria.undesired: A dashcam image of a vehicle or person that appears excessively large or small for its distance and surroundings.
criteria.preferred: A dashcam image of a vehicle or person at a realistic scale for its distance and surroundings.

criteria.undesired: A dashcam image of a vehicle positioned at an unnatural angle and location relative to the road layout.
criteria.preferred: A dashcam image of a vehicle positioned naturally along the road and aligned with its layout.

criteria.undesired: A dashcam image of objects unnaturally fused through one another, with distorted and tangled boundaries.
criteria.preferred: A dashcam image of distinct objects with clear boundaries and natural occlusion between them.

criteria.undesired: A dashcam image of a normal traffic scene with vehicles traveling along the road.
criteria.preferred: A dashcam image of a road traffic accident involving one or more vehicles.
